title: Decanter of Nearly Endless Water
summary: Throw as an Action up to 60 ft. Creates Water within a 7 ft radius and makes creatures in the splash Wet for 3 turns.

fields.Wet: Grants Fire resistance and Burning immunity and can make creatures vulnerable to Lightning and Cold. Existing resistance to either is instead negated.
fields.Base value: 60 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
